name: recorded_request_1
question: 只看至少有20条观众评价的电影，哪些电影的平均评分排进前20，但扣掉退款后的收入没有进前20？把评分、评价数量、收入和两项排名列出来。

candidates.sql:
WITH movie_stats AS (
  SELECT
    m.movie_id,
    m.title,
    COALESCE(AVG(mr.rating), 0) AS viewer_average_rating,
    COUNT(mr.review_id) AS review_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(to.total_amount - to.refund_amount), 0) AS net_revenue
  FROM movies m
  LEFT JOIN movie_reviews mr ON m.movie_id = mr.movie_id
  LEFT JOIN screenings s ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id
  LEFT JOIN ticket_orders to ON s.screening_id = to.screening_id
  GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.title
  HAVING COUNT(mr.review_id) >= 20
),
ranked_movies AS (
  SELECT
    title,
    viewer_average_rating,
    review_count,
    net_revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY viewer_average_rating DESC, movie_id) AS rating_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, movie_id) AS revenue_rank
  FROM movie_stats
)
SELECT
  title,
  viewer_average_rating,
  review_count,
  net_revenue,
  rating_rank,
  revenue_rank
FROM ranked_movies
WHERE rating_rank <= 20 AND revenue_rank > 20
ORDER BY rating_rank
LIMIT 200
